name: Ezio Auditore
bio: Archetype: Assassination, Extra Action, Ultimate Damage, Poison. ⌽ Instead of using Moxie, gains [Synchronization] from using skills that trigger [Assasination] in order to cast Ultimate. ⌽ Skills are considered [Assassination]s. Gains [Master Assassin], enhancing the effects of [Assassination]. When attacked while at low HP, enters [Shadowstalk], increasing Crit DMG. ⌽ Skill 2 taunts target(s), reduces damage taken for self and ripostes all attacks that turn with [Counter Kill]. ⌽ Ultimate casts [Arrow of Faith]/[Edge of Faith] multiple times, dealing additional damage if the target's HP is above/below a certain percentage before casting [Death be not Unkind]. ⌽ Uses a weapon system for ability enhancement. Primary weapon choice determines between extra action, Ultimate, and [Poison] utility, and secondary weapon choice determines granular effects.
